From: Emma Clark <emma.clark@atriahealth.com>

Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 15:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC discovery — next steps

Thanks for the call today, Karthik — quick recap from my side and a couple of asks so we can lock the POC window.

Summary from AtriaHealth:
- Goal: Validate Redwood deployment for clinical-summary generation across 3 internal teams (triage, intake, clinician notes).
- Constraints: 
  - Average prompt length ~230 tokens, peak concurrent users expected ~40 during batch runs.
  - Security: we need VPC/private deployment for PHI; will share security checklist separately.

What we need from Redwood to qualify the pilot:
1) Concrete success thresholds for latency/throughput/cost/quality so we can align internal stakeholders.
2) A short ops/runbook that outlines who owns what during the trial (on-call escalation, monitoring, rollback).
3) A sample measurement template (spreadsheet) we can use to log results during validation.

Tentative timing: hoping to start the POC week of Jul 12 and run ~4 weeks. Can Redwood confirm availability for that window and provide the thresholds by Friday (Jul 3)?

Thanks — Emma
Emma Clark
Program Manager, Clinical Ops
AtriaHealth

Hi Emma — great to meet today, and thanks for the clear priorities. Looping Lauren (product ops) and Marissa (technical PM) to own the POC runbook and measurement artifacts.

Below are draft success criteria and next steps. This is intentionally conservative; we'll refine after your workload sample.

Draft POC success thresholds (baseline):
- Latency (generation only, 2k context): P50 < 200 ms, P95 < 650 ms
- Throughput: sustained 40 requests/sec for 3-minute windows; burst capacity to 80 req/sec for 30s
- Cost: average inference cost < $0.0012 per token for the pilot workload (we'll break down by model variant)
- Quality: automated quality checks on the gold set — top-1 acceptance rate >= 90% and human spot-check pass rate >= 92% on prioritized prompts
- Reliability: 99.5% successful request rate (no error) during business hours

Operational handoff (owners):
- Redwood: onboarding, model/quantization recommendations, runtime tuning, SLO alerts (Owner: Marissa Cole)
- AtriaHealth: provide production-like workload samples, acceptance prompt set, and security evidence (Owner: Emma Clark)
- Product ops: measurement template, dashboard access, weekly readout (Owner: Lauren Bishop)

Proposed timeline and milestones:
- Jul 3: Agreement on thresholds + shared Drive folder with sample workload and acceptance prompts
- Jul 7: Redwood provides POC-Metrics-Template.xlsx and network-reqs.pdf (attached)
- Jul 12: POC start — sandbox environment provisioned; warmup and smoke tests first 48 hours
- Jul 19: Midpoint readout — performance and quality checkpoint
- Aug 9: Final readout and decision (pass/fail + next steps for Dedicated or Private deployment)

Immediate asks for your team by EOD Jul 3:
1) Confirm POC start week of Jul 12 and the 4-week cadence works.
2) Share a 1-2k sample of typical prompts (CSV) and the gold-label acceptance set (if available).

Attachments sent with this email: POC-Metrics-Template.xlsx, network-requirements.pdf, SOW-draft.docx

We'll treat the thresholds above as the working proposal until we receive your sample workload and finalize during the kickoff.

Cheers,
Karthik
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com

Adding ops detail and owner lanes for the pilot. Notes below are operational requirements we need to confirm with Atria before Jul 7 so we can provision correctly.

Operational checklist (Lauren):
- Environment: VPC peering + static egress IPs required? Confirm. (Affects network-reqs.pdf)
- Monitoring / dashboards: allocate a shared Grafana project with token-level cost panels and P50/P95 latency charts (Owner: Redwood SRE via Marissa)
- Escalation: 24hr SLA on critical incidents during pilot window; on-call rotation: Marissa -> Karthik -> Redwood infra team
- Data retention: temporary logs only; we will not persist PHI artifacts beyond test window unless explicitly requested (need written approval)

Measurement template (Marissa):
- We'll populate POC-Metrics-Template.xlsx with columns: timestamp, prompt_id, tokens_in, tokens_out, model_variant, latency_ms, status_code, cost_est_usd, automated_score, human_review_pass (Y/N)
- We'll include a sheet for midpoint and final readout with summary charts

Operational asks for Atria (to send by Jul 3):
1) Sample CSV (1-2k prompts) and gold-labels
2) Confirmation on network/VPC details for peering
3) Primary point of contact for data security (for SOC2 evidence exchange)

If those arrive by EOD Jul 3 we can keep Jul 12 start. Otherwise, we'll need to push the kickoff to the week of Jul 19.

Lauren Bishop
Manager, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
